vMatrix.notes: The two sources agree on which skills matter and disagree only in presentation, not substance: Grandis Library lists skills grouped per boost node (Wakeup Call alone in one group, Mountain Kid and Mountain Seeds in another), while mystyjl combines the same three skills into a single second trio. Neither source gives an explicit leveling order within a trio, and neither splits Lara's trios into bossing versus mobbing variants. Staleness caveat: Grandis Library exposes a 'View Pre-V.269 Boost Nodes' toggle, which is direct evidence that boost node groupings changed at v.269; mystyjl's page is dated 2024-11-21 with underlying data from 2024-05-14 and therefore predates that regrouping. That its trios still match the post-v.269 Grandis listing is corroborating, but the agreement should be re-checked against the Lara Discord.

hexa.notes: NO PUBLIC SOURCE FOR LARA'S HEXA INVESTMENT ORDER COULD BE READ. Findings, each sourced: (1) Grandis Library's Lara page has no HEXA section and lists no class doc under Other Resources, only the class Discord and a HEXA Matrix Tracker sheet (https://grandislibrary.com/anima/lara). (2) The linked Lara HEXA Progression sheet is a fill-in calculator - it asks for your current HEXA progress and your target levels and derives recommendations from them, rather than publishing a fixed order; its credits line traces the template through a chain of other class Discords before reaching the Lara Discord (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KsSTOkGa5yU5lKb10RCjMQlXNWiThNT3TanLWcONYaU). (3) MapleDoro's Lara page displays a single image captioned as a Heroic HEXA guide and marks its own 6th job leveling-order section as work in progress, directing readers to the class Discord for infographics (https://www.mapledoro.com/guides/character-guides/lara). (4) DigitalTQ's Lara page contains skill descriptions but explicitly no HEXA investment order (https://www.digitaltq.com/maplestory-lara-skill-build). The order therefore exists publicly only as a Discord-distributed infographic image, which was not readable here. Do not populate this field from inference. Skill names appearing in Lara's HEXA/6th job context, recorded for name validation only and with no priority attached: Universe in Bloom (identified as the Origin skill by DigitalTQ), Sol Janus and Sol Hecate (common skills), and HEXA versions of Essence Sprinkle and Dragon Vein Eruption. 'Cornucopia' also appears as a tracked entry in the Lara HEXA Progression sheet but its node type was not confirmed by any source read here.

hyperStats.notes: NO SOURCE FOUND. Grandis Library carries no hyper stat allocation for any class, there is no public Lara class document, and no other reachable page gave a Lara hyper stat ordering. Note the cross-class position recorded elsewhere in this project: the community's operative answer to hyper stat priority is a per-character computation (MathBro's hyper stat optimizer at https://brendonmay.github.io/hyperCalculator/), not a fixed list, and at least one class doc in this ecosystem declines to publish a fixed order for that reason. Leaving this empty is the correct state until the Lara Discord is read.

gearingNotes: Sourced facts that bear on gearing, all from the base-stats-from-skills table on https://grandislibrary.com/anima/lara (single source, GMS v.269 stamp): Lara's own passives supply +45% crit rate, +20% crit damage, +10% boss damage before class-skill conditionals, and +40% ignore DEF before conditionals; attack speed contributions from skills are +2 (Wand Booster) and +1 (Manifestation / Advanced Mastery); weapon mastery 95%; weapon multiplier 1.2x; INT +40 and +15% to assigned AP. The crit rate figure is the one with real gearing consequence, since it sets how much additional crit rate must come from links, legion, hyper stats and inner ability - but no source read here states a crit rate target for Lara, so none is recorded. No source was found describing any unusual stat weighting, resource mechanic or gauge interaction for Lara in gearing terms; Lara's Dragon Vein mechanic is described on the wiki-style pages but none of the reachable sources tie it to a gearing decision.

evidenceGaps: No public Lara class document exists. Grandis Library's Lara page lists no class doc under Other Resources, and MapleDoro directs readers to the class Discord instead. This is the root cause of every gap below.
HEXA investment order: no readable public source. Exists only as a Discord-distributed infographic image.
Hyper stat priority: no source at all for Lara.
Hyper skill active selections: not covered by any source read.
Archetype classification and any class-specific gearing quirk beyond the raw passive stat totals: not sourced.

Only two independent lanes were reachable (Grandis/Lara Discord family, and mystyjl), against a three-independent-source standard. Reddit is blocked by policy in this environment, maplestorywiki.net and maplerhouse.com returned 403 to fetching, the browser pane returned content from pages other than the ones requested and was discarded as unreliable, and the web search budget was exhausted before this task began.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: MISATTRIBUTION (not an invented name, but a claim a source does not make): the Wakeup Call entry says 'Grandis Library places it one tier below the top three, in the tier it labels as frequently used skills.' Wrong label. 'Frequently used' belongs to Grandis's PRIMARY definition - verbatim: 'Boost Nodes that unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery and are skills that are frequently used'. SECONDARY is defined verbatim as 'Boost Nodes that don't unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery but are still used'. The file attaches the wrong label and loses the actual reason for the tier split, which is HEXA Mastery unlock.

UNDERSTATED FACT: gearingNotes says 'attack speed contributions from skills are +2 (Wand Booster) and +1 (Manifestation / Advanced Mastery)'. Grandis lists THREE separate contributions: +2 Wand Booster (2nd Job), +1 Manifestation: Wind Swing - Passive (3rd Job), +1 Advanced Wand Mastery (4th Job), totalling Stage 4. The file collapses two distinct +1 sources into one and never records the total 'Stage 4', which is the number that actually drives attack-speed gearing decisions.
clearedOnInspection: NO invented node or skill names found. I checked every one. All eight boost node names (Essence Sprinkle, Dragon Vein Eruption, Dragon Vein Absorption, Wakeup Call, Mountain Kid, Mountain Seeds, Dragon Vein Traces, Vine Coil) are attested by both Grandis Library and mystyjl. Hyper skill names (Mountain Embrace, Dragon Vein, Vine Coil) and all inner ability lines are verbatim-attested on Grandis. Universe in Bloom is confirmed as Lara's 6th job skill by BOTH Grandis and DigitalTQ. I specifically suspected 'Sol Hecate' and 'Cornucopia' as fabrications and tried to break them - both appear in the linked Lara HEXA Progression sheet (fetched via the gviz CSV endpoint), alongside Big Stretch, Land's Connection, Surging Essence and Winding Mountain Ridge. The researcher's caution on Cornucopia ('node type not confirmed') was correctly calibrated.
NO invented priority order. hexa.order and hyperStats.priority are correctly left empty with the reason documented, and the empty-field discipline is the strongest part of this file.

blockedReason: 2 claim(s) did not survive independent re-checking. See contest.defects. This file is research, not guidance, until they are resolved.
